questions.label: B1(a)
questions.question_text: CLIENT ID is the primary key of the CLIENTS table. State what is meant by a primary key.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: A field that uniquely identifies each record (no two records have the same value).
Check / do not accept: A "key field" with no explanation: no mark.

questions.label: B1(b)
questions.question_text: CLIENT ID is the primary key of the CLIENTS table. Identify the foreign key in the EVENTS table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: CLIENT ID.

questions.label: B2(1)
questions.question_text: State the type of relationship between the CLIENTS table and the EVENTS table. Explain your answer.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: One-to-many.
Check / do not accept: Many-to-one only if the explanation is correct.

questions.label: B2(2)
questions.question_text: State the type of relationship between the CLIENTS table and the EVENTS table. Explain your answer.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: One client can book many events, but each event is booked by only one client.

questions.label: B3(1)
questions.question_text: Explain one advantage of storing this data in two linked tables rather than in one table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Data is stored once / not repeated (less redundancy), e.g. a client's name and contact number are stored once, not with every event.

questions.label: B3(2)
questions.question_text: Explain one advantage of storing this data in two linked tables rather than in one table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: So it is changed in only one place / fewer inconsistencies / less storage space.

questions.label: B4(a)(1)
questions.question_text: Referential integrity is enforced in this database. Explain why referential integrity is enforced between the CLIENTS table and the EVENTS table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: An event cannot be entered for a CLIENT ID that does not exist in CLIENTS (or a client with events cannot be deleted).

questions.label: B4(a)(2)
questions.question_text: Referential integrity is enforced in this database. Explain why referential integrity is enforced between the CLIENTS table and the EVENTS table.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: This stops records that are not linked (orphan records) / reduces data entry errors.

questions.label: B4(b)
questions.question_text: Referential integrity is enforced in this database. State which table must have its data entered first.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: CLIENTS.

questions.label: B5(a)
questions.question_text: State the data type of the LOYALTY MEMBER field in the CLIENTS table.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Yes/No (accept Boolean).
Check / do not accept: Text: no mark.

questions.label: B5(b)
questions.question_text: The CONTACT NUMBER field has the data type Text. Give one reason why it is not stored as a Number.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: A Number field would remove the leading 0 / it is not used in calculations / it may contain + or spaces.

questions.label: B5(c)
questions.question_text: Suggest a suitable field size for the CONTACT NUMBER field.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: 10 (accept 10–15).
Check / do not accept: 255, 50 or default: no mark.

questions.label: B6(a)
questions.question_text: Identify one field in the EVENTS table that uses a lookup list.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: EVENT TYPE or VENUE.

questions.label: B6(b)(1)
questions.question_text: The EVENT TYPE lookup list has Limit to List set to Yes. Explain one benefit of this.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Only values in the list can be entered.

questions.label: B6(b)(2)
questions.question_text: The EVENT TYPE lookup list has Limit to List set to Yes. Explain one benefit of this.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: So the data is consistent / spelt the same, and a query for e.g. "Wedding" finds every wedding.

Check / do not accept: Length check: no mark.

questions.label: B7(b)
questions.question_text: Name the validation check that makes sure the CONTACT NUMBER field cannot be left blank.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Presence check (accept Required = Yes).

questions.label: B7(c)(1)
questions.question_text: The number of GUESTS must be between 10 and 500. Name the validation check that should be used and write a suitable validation rule.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: Range check.

questions.label: B7(c)(2)
questions.question_text: The number of GUESTS must be between 10 and 500. Name the validation check that should be used and write a suitable validation rule.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: >=10 And <=500 (accept Between 10 And 500).
Check / do not accept: Only one limit: no mark.

questions.label: B7(d)
questions.question_text: State one suitable validation check for the EVENT DATE field.
questions.mark_scheme:
Award the mark for: Type check (must be a valid date) / range check (e.g. >=Date()) / format check (dd/mm/yyyy).
Check / do not accept: Presence check alone: no mark.

questions.label: B8(a)
questions.question_text: State why a query may need a logical operator such as AND or OR.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: To search using more than one criterion / to combine conditions.

questions.label: B8(b)(1)
questions.question_text: Explain one reason why Like "*Tent*" would be used in a search on the VENUE field.
questions.mark_scheme: Award the mark for: The * wildcard stands for any characters / finds partial matches.
